caption: A green glass is held up to the light in front of a white wall, and the wall looks green through it.

sa.check: A green glass is held up to the light in front of a wall.
The wall looks green through it.

pc.expect: The wall looks green only where the glass's light reaches and while it is on.
pc.fail: The wall is green with the glass off; or stays white under the green light; or turns a different colour from the light.

pc.expect: The change happens at the same instant as the glass and is confined to where its light falls.
pc.fail: The wall changes before the glass; or long after; or surfaces the light cannot reach change too.

pc.expect: The wall through the glass is the same wall, tinted and shifted only by the glass's curve.
pc.fail: A different scene appears; or it is mirrored; or it is enlarged far beyond the glass.

pc.expect: Nothing moves; only the light changes.
pc.fail: The wall moves; or the glass moves by itself; or the lit area wanders.
A second glass appears; or the wall vanishes; or the light becomes solid.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The wall's shape and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The wall changes shape; or the surroundings rearrange; or the glass changes shape.

note: The hand is the minimal trigger; the person is not judged.
